data.title: Werksstudent:in / Working Student Social Media
data.description:
yummy wurde 2021 in München gegründet, mit einer Mission, die in drei Worte passt: Real Food. Now. Wir machen gesunde Instant Meals, die schmecken.

Wir wachsen dreistellig und haben unseren Umsatz im letzten Jahr verdoppelt. Heute stehen wir in über 2.000 Supermärkten in Deutschland, bis Jahresende sollen es mehr als 6.000 sein. Mit unseren Paid-Social-Kampagnen erreichen wir über die Hälfte aller Nutzer:innen in Deutschland. Zwölf Produkte, eine aggressive Launch-Strategie, eine Community, die wächst. Und eine Marke, die gerade erst anfängt.

Was uns fehlt: Die Person, die yummy zur nächsten großen Lovebrand in Deutschland und darüber hinaus macht. Vielleicht bist du das.

Aufgaben

  • Content für Instagram und TikTok mitdenken und produzieren, von Reels bis Stories
  • Kurzform-Videos filmen und cutten, von der Idee bis zum fertigen Cut
  • Trends, Sounds und Formate erkennen und für Yummy übersetzen
  • Community-Arbeit: Kommentare beantworten, mit unserer Community im Austausch sein
  • In Team-Meetings Ideen einbringen und mitentwickeln

Qualifikation

  • Du bist auf Instagram und TikTok zuhause und weißt, was funktioniert und warum
  • Praxis im Filmen und Cutten von Kurzform-Content (CapCut, Canva)
  • Ein Auge für Bildsprache und eigene kreative Ideen
  • Du fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, strukturiert und packst Dinge proaktiv an
  • 15–20 Std./Woche verfügbar, flexibel rund um Prüfungsphasen
  • Eingeschrieben an einer Uni (Bachelor oder Master), bevorzugt in der Fachrichtung Marketing, Kommunikation, Design oder Medien, für die Dauer der Anstellung
  • Deutsch fließend in Wort und Schrift, Englisch mindestens B2
  • Wir sind ein kleines Team und sehen uns gern 2–3 Mal pro Woche im Büro in München, je nach deiner Verfügbarkeit — den Rest kannst du remote arbeiten

Benefits

  • Start-up-Tempo mit echtem Impact statt Zuschauerrolle
  • Flexible Zeiten, die sich nach deinem Studium richten
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Yummy-Team
  • Viel Freiraum für eigene Formate, Ideen und Konzepte
  • Die Chance, Yummys Social Media aktiv mitzuprägen

Ein generischer PDF-Lebenslauf zeigt uns nicht, was in dir steckt — wir wollen deine Kreativität sehen. Sei nicht poliert, zeig uns deine Persönlichkeit. Sei mutig, sei witzig, zeig deinen Spark — als Video (60s+), Präsentation oder auf deine eigene Art, Hauptsache wir merken, was du drauf hast.

data.title: Director Professional Services & Cloud Operations (m/w/x)
data.description:
Die VertiGIS Unternehmensgruppe entwickelt Softwarelösungen für Geografische Informationssysteme (GIS). Wir sind führender Lösungsanbieter in den Bereichen Energieversorgung, Wasserwirtschaft, Landmanagement, Behörden, Infrastruktur, Facility Management und Telekommunikation. Unsere Produkte helfen Unternehmen, Netze, Anlagen und Prozesse effizient zu planen, zu verwalten und zu optimieren – weltweit im täglichen Einsatz.

Die Business Unit Land Management unterstützt öffentliche Verwaltungen bei der Digitalisierung von Vermessung, Kataster und Geoinformation. Die VertiGIS LM Cloud bildet die Grundlage für neue cloudbasierte Betriebs- und Servicemodelle.

Die Position entwickelt Professional Services und Cloud Operations strategisch weiter und skaliert die Organisation für Managed-Cloud- und Subscription-Services. Sie führt die verantwortlichen Führungskräfte und verantwortet einen Bereich mit rund 40 Mitarbeitenden.

Die Aufgaben

Cloud- und Servicegeschäft

  • Strategische Weiterentwicklung von Cloud Operations, Managed Services und Betriebsmodellen für die LM Cloud

  • Gestaltung der Transformation von projektorientierten Leistungen zu standardisierten Cloud-, Managed-Service- und Subscription-Angeboten

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung der Roadmap für Cloud-Geschäft, Services und Operations einschließlich geeigneter KPIs und wirtschaftlicher Zielgröße

Führung und Organisationsentwicklung

  • Führung und Entwicklung der Team Leads sowie weiterer Führungskräfte in Professional Services und Cloud Operations

  • Gestaltung und Skalierung der Organisation durch Organisationsentwicklung, Kompetenzaufbau und Change Management

  • Definition von Verantwortlichkeiten, Standards und Entscheidungswegen für die Zusammenarbeit über mehrere Teams hinweg

Kunden-, Partner- und Geschäftsentwicklung

  • Beratung von Kunden und Partnern bei strategischen Fragen der Digitalisierung, Cloud-Einführung und Transformation

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Vertrieb und Angebotsmanagement bei strategisch wichtigen Vorhaben und Großprojekten

  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung von Technologie- und Umsetzungspartnern für Cloud-, Managed-Service- und Subscription-Angebote


Die Stelle erfordert mehrjährige Erfahrung in folgenden Bereichen:

  • Verantwortung für strategische Transformationsprogramme in den Bereichen Cloud, Services oder digitale Geschäftsmodelle

  • Führung von Team Leads oder anderen Führungskräften sowie Organisationsentwicklung und Change Management

  • Aufbau und Skalierung von Serviceorganisationen sowie Transformation projektorientierter Geschäftsmodelle hin zu Managed-Cloud- und Serviceangeboten

  • Erstellung und Bewertung von Business Cases, Investitionsentscheidungen und wirtschaftlicher Steuerung von Organisationseinheiten unter Berücksichtigung von Profitabilität, Auslastung und Skalierung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen, Geschäftsführungen, Behördenleitungen oder vergleichbaren Entscheidern

Zusätzlich erforderlich sind Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau und Englischkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau.

Wünschenswert

  • Fachwissen zu GIS und Land Management

  • Kenntnisse des deutschen Behördenmarktes

  • Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 sowie mit Projektmanagement-, BI- und ERP-Lösungen, beispielsweise Microsoft Project, Power BI und NetSuite

Unsere Rahmenbedingungen

✔️ 30 Tage Urlaub & flexible Arbeitszeiten - für Ihre Work-Life-Balance

✔️ Mobiles Arbeiten - flexibel von zuhause oder unterwegs innerhalb Deutschlands

✔️ Internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit regelmäßigem Austausch

✔️ Individuell wählbare Benefits (monatlich bis zu 80 € für z. B. Gutscheine, Zuschüsse zu Internetkosten, Mahlzeiten, ÖPNV)

✔️ KiTa-Zuschuss - weil uns Familienfreundlichkeit wichtig ist

data.description:
Your Mission

  • You will collaborate on the design, development, deployment and maintenance of our web application, utilising modern technologies while adhering to industry best practices
  • You will work autonomously and contribute to architectural decisions alongside your team
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to build impactful solutions for the climate sector
  • Improve development workflow and contribute to building an efficient, high-performance engineering culture
  • Leverage AI coding tools as a core part of your development workflow to ship faster and maintain high code quality


Your Talent

  • You have at least 5+ years of software development experience
  • Strong expertise in React, Python, FastAPI, React, Redux Toolkit, and TanStack Router
  • Comfort using AI coding tools to accelerate development
  • Experience building AI-powered features
  • Experience in developing complex forms using react-hook-form and zod while ensuring a responsive and frictionless user journey
  • Proficiency in Tailwind CSS and modern UI development practices
  • You can evaluate what’s hype versus what’s real business value
  • You have a good understanding of Docker, AWS and cloud native architecture
  • You have experience debugging and resolving production issues
  • You have led large complex projects from beginning to end
  • You have excellent communication skills in English, and experience with distributed teams is a plus


Our Offer

Growth & Culture
We move fast, we're building a lot from scratch, and we're learning something new every day. You'll be part of a team that doesn't just work, it truly builds something, with a strong sense of ownership and genuine team spirit.

Impact
Your job has a direct impact on the energy transition. Period.
And because this is important to us, we offer extra days off for climate activism.

Flexibility
We work in a hybrid, trust-based environment.
Working from home is the norm for us, two days a week are standard and flexible. We structure the rest in whatever way best supports collaboration and focus within the team.
And if it works for you and your team, you can also work from other locations, workations are possible here.

Perks
You'll receive a flexible bonus that you can use however you like, sports, culture, travel, whatever works for you.

Food & Energy
Long days happen. When the office is running, so is the food: just order something to the office via Wolt.

Team & Vibe
We take our mission seriously, but we don't take ourselves too seriously.
Offsites, team nights, and our "Bees & Beers" are just as much a part of the job as the work itself.

data.title: AI Augmented Software Engineer [gn] Data Intelligence Platform
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Augmented Software Engineer [gn] Data Intelligence Platform based in Germany.

This is an opportunity for a full-stack engineer to help build a modern data intelligence platform that enables organisations to discover, govern, and trust their data.
You’ll work end-to-end across backend services and frontend experiences, taking features from initial concept through production delivery.
AI coding assistants will be a core part of your engineering toolkit, helping you accelerate development while keeping human judgment at the center of technical decisions.
You’ll contribute to scalable SaaS products where correctness, security, performance, and maintainability are critical.
The role offers significant autonomy, encouraging you to identify problems, shape solutions, and move initiatives forward without waiting for detailed instructions.
You’ll collaborate closely with product managers and engineers in an agile, feedback-driven environment focused on continuous improvement.
It’s an ideal setting for a pragmatic builder who wants to multiply their engineering impact through thoughtful use of AI.


Accountabilities
  • Design and implement full-stack product features across backend services and frontend interfaces, ensuring strong performance, reliability, security, and maintainability.
  • Take ownership of features from understanding requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, and comparable tools deliberately to accelerate development, reduce repetitive work, explore solutions, improve test coverage, and increase engineering leverage.
  • Apply sound engineering judgment when using AI-generated output, reviewing, validating, and improving solutions rather than relying on automation without oversight.
  • Participate actively in technical design discussions and code reviews, promoting clean architecture, secure development practices, and testable code.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and participate in incident response, taking shared responsibility for the stability and reliability of the platform.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand customer and business requirements early and translate them into clear, achievable technical solutions.
  • Share technical knowledge with colleagues through documentation, technical sessions, and internal development practices.
  • Help establish and improve AI-assisted engineering practices, contributing reusable approaches, workflows, and lessons learned across the team.
  • Contribute to an agile working environment based on short feedback loops, iterative delivery, collaboration, and continuous learning.

    • Requirements:

    • Proven professional experience as a full-stack software engineer, with a track record of independently building and shipping production features in SaaS environments.
    • Demonstrated experience using AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar tools as an integrated part of your development workflow.
    • Strong engineering judgment and the ability to recognize when AI-generated solutions are useful, incomplete, misleading, or require deeper human analysis.
    • Practical experience with Scala or Java on the backend and TypeScript and Angular on the frontend is highly valuable; expertise across every technology is not required, but you should be willing and able to grow across the stack.
    • Solid understanding of SaaS architecture and cloud fundamentals, particularly within AWS environments.
    • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub workflows, and CI/CD pipelines.
    • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, including clean architecture, testing, maintainability, performance, and secure development.
    • A genuine agile mindset, with a preference for iterative delivery, rapid feedback, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
    • Strong product thinking and the ability to translate business and user requirements into well-scoped technical solutions.
    • Comfortable working with autonomy, taking initiative, and driving work forward without requiring every task to be explicitly assigned.
    • Strong communication and knowledge-sharing skills within collaborative engineering teams.
    • Full professional proficiency in English.
    • Experience with data governance, data catalogs, metadata management, or data intelligence platforms is a significant advantage.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
      • Flexible working arrangements, including remote or hybrid options.
      • Opportunity to work on an innovative data intelligence platform with real-world enterprise impact.
      • Exposure to AI-assisted software engineering and the opportunity to help shape modern development practices.
      • High level of autonomy and ownership in a builder-oriented environment.
      • Collaboration with a passionate, diverse, and internationally minded engineering team.
      • Opportunities for professional growth, technical development, and continuous learning.
      • Agile, collaborative culture focused on outcomes, experimentation, and short feedback loops.
      • Inclusive working environment where qualified candidates are encouraged to apply regardless of background or identity.

data.title: Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/f/d)
data.description:
Intro

Back problems are the most common cause of work incapacity in Germany.

Vivira has the solution: We provide digital movement therapy via app. Always available, simple, effective, and reimbursed by health insurance. Vivira was born out of the need to treat musculoskeletal conditions as simply and effectively as possible.


Your responsibilities include

As Senior Product Manager Digital Health (m/f/d), you play a central role in developing and expanding our existing digital therapy offering. 

You drive forward how we can support patients and physicians even better in treating and reducing musculoskeletal pain. Depending on your experience and current focus, you take ownership of a central product or growth area along our patient, therapy, or practice journey – acting as the interface between medical relevance, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements, and commercial success. 

You conceive, validate, and prioritize new product and service ideas and prepare them for implementation in a structured way. Your work lays the foundation for expanding our product and service portfolio, strengthens long-term customer relationships, and creates lasting value – beyond the actual therapy phase.


What you should bring

  • Experience: Several years of solid product management experience (typically 5+ years), e.g. as Senior, Lead, or Principal Product Manager or Product Owner, ideally in Digital Health, MedTech, DiGA, or similar fields. You have independently owned a digital product area and can show how your decisions changed user and business outcomes.
  • Outcome-driven product development: You steer by impact, not output – data-driven decisions come naturally to you.
  • Stakeholder management and cross-functional leadership: You communicate confidently with C-level, Engineering, Regulatory, and the clinical team.
  • Mindset: You bring strong empathy for the medical context, act proactively, and have a solution-oriented, hands-on mentality.
  • AI fluency: You use AI pragmatically in discovery, research, analysis, or prototyping and can judge where it accelerates product work – and where human judgement remains essential.
  • Language: Excellent German and English (C1 or above in both) – neither needs to be your native language.

Nice to have
  • Experience in Healthcare, Digital Health, HealthTech, MedTech, Pharma, Digital Therapeutics, or Clinical Software – ideally with direct DiGA experience and knowledge of the regulatory framework (DiGA, MDR).
  • Experience working with physicians, practice teams, medical assistants, patients, or other healthcare stakeholders.


What to expect at Vivira

  • Workplace: Work from home or from our centrally located Berlin HQ.
  • Working abroad: The option to work remotely for up to one month per year from the EU, EEA, Switzerland, Israel, or the UK.
  • Recharge: 30 vacation days – for real breaks and new energy.

  • Secure your future: Build for tomorrow today with an increased employer contribution to your pension plan.
  • Corporate benefits: Enjoy exclusive advantages for shopping, tech, and more.
  • Referral bonus: Sharing your network pays off – every successful referral is rewarded.
  • Highlights: Several company and team events per year create exchange, fun, and a real sense of community.

data.title: Werkstudent:in Retail Expansion / Retail Growth (m/w/d) in Berlin Mitte
data.description:
Dein Impact

Bei Juit ermöglichen wir unseren Kunden, sich jeden Tag gesund zu ernähren, indem wir von Köchen und Köchinnen zubereitete Mahlzeiten direkt nach Hause liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, die Nummer 1 unter den Marken für gesunde Mahlzeiten in Deutschland zu werden, indem wir unseren Kunden das beste Online-, Essens- und Liefererlebnis bieten.

Um unsere Präsenz vor Ort in Berlin Mitte massiv auszubauen und neue Kunden für unsere Marke zu begeistern, suchen wir ab sofort echte Macher (m/w/d) für unser lokales Store-Team.

Du hast Lust auf Start-up-Vibe, liebst den direkten Kundenkontakt und willst aktiv daran mitarbeiten, unseren Store zum Erfolg zu führen? Dann werde Teil unserer Growth-Story!

Als Werkstudent:in im Bereich Retail Growth bist du unser Aushängeschild und treibst das lokale Wachstum direkt an der Basis voran. Deine Aufgaben sind ein Mix aus Hands-on-Operations und proaktiver Kundenakquise:

  • Local Marketing & Customer Acquisition: Du bist der Motor für unsere Frequenz im Store! Du gehst charmant und selbstbewusst auf Passanten vor unserem Store zu, machst sie auf unsere Marke aufmerksam und holst sie aktiv auf die Verkaufsfläche.

  • Brand Ambassadorship & Sales: Du bist der erste Touchpoint für unsere Kunden. Du berätst sie mit Begeisterung, beantwortest Fragen und schaffst ein Einkaufserlebnis, das im Gedächtnis bleibt.

  • Store Operations: Wachstum braucht Struktur. Du unterstützt im Tagesgeschäft, übernimmst den Kassiervorgang und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Waren optimal präsentiert und nachgefüllt sind.

  • Growth Insights: Du bist unser Ohr am Markt! Du sammelst direktes Kundenfeedback und teilst deine Erkenntnisse mit dem Team, um unsere lokale Retail-Strategie stetig zu verbessern.


Deine Stärken

  • Du hast eine offene, mitreißende Persönlichkeit und absolut keine Scheu, fremde Menschen aktiv anzusprechen.

  • „Hands-on“ ist dein zweiter Vorname – du packst gerne mit an und behältst auch an frequenzstarken Tagen den Überblick.

  • Du bist aktuell an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert (ideal, aber kein Muss: Studiengänge wie BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation, Retail Management).

  • Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch (weitere Sprachen sind ein großes Plus) und hast Lust, Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Bereich Promotion, Sales, Gastronomie oder Retail sind super, aber vor allem zählt deine Motivation!


Unser Versprechen

  • Engagiertes Team mit talentierten und inspirierenden KollegInnen

  • Interessante Tätigkeit in einem wachsenden Unternehmen mit der Chance, sich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Strukturierte Einarbeitung und Verantwortung vom ersten Tag an

  • Mitarbeiterrabatt auf unsere Juit Boxen

  • Ein moderner Arbeitsplatz

data.title: Senior Data Engineer (d/w/m)
data.description:
Deine Mission

Als Senior Data Engineer (d/w/m) bei SpotmyEnergy wirst Du Teil eines energiegeladenen Teams, das die Energiewende in die Haushalte bringt! Bei uns baust und betreibst Du das Rückgrat unserer Datenorganisation – unseren Data Lake und unsere BI-Plattform auf Databricks sowie die Airflow-Pipelines, die unsere Mess- und Energiedaten am Laufen halten. Unser Datenteam versteht sich als Service für das ganze Unternehmen, und genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel.

Du modellierst und optimierst unsere Postgres- und Zeitreihendatenbanken, denkst Monitoring und Alerting von Anfang an mit und sorgst dafür, dass jedes Squad auf saubere, gut dokumentierte Daten zugreifen kann. Mit modernen Tools auf AWS und einem Team im Rücken baust Du eine Plattform, die mit uns mitwächst.

Deine Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Aufbau und Betrieb unseres Data Lake sowie der BI-Plattform auf Databricks
  • Entwurf, Bau und Wartung von Airflow-Pipelines für Messwert- und Energiedaten
  • Modellierung und Optimierung unserer Postgres- und Zeitreihendatenbanken
  • Verantwortung für Monitoring, Alerting und Incident Response, damit Probleme früh auffallen statt spät
  • Bereitstellung sauberer, gut strukturierter Daten als Service für alle Squads, inklusive eigener Deep-Dive-Analysen bei Bedarf
  • Technische Weiterentwicklung der Datenplattform, inklusive Auswahl und Einführung neuer Tools, wo sie echten Mehrwert bringen
  • Dokumentation und aktive Wissensteilung im Team, statt Wissen nur im eigenen Kopf zu behalten
  • Enger Austausch mit dem Data-Science-Team, das sich auf die Plattform als Fundament verlassen können soll

Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im Aufbau und Betrieb produktiver Datenplattformen oder Data Lakes
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Databricks/Spark sowie Airflow oder vergleichbaren Orchestrierungstools
  • Sehr gutes SQL, tiefe Postgres-Erfahrung, Erfahrung mit Zeitreihendatenbanken wie TimescaleDB und sicheres Python
  • Sicherer Umgang mit AWS, idealerweise inklusive managed Airflow über Astronomer und Databricks als Hosted Service
  • Ein echtes Zuverlässigkeits-Mindset – Monitoring, Alerting und mögliche Fehlerfälle werden von Anfang an mitgedacht
  • Starker Teamplayer mit fließenden Deutschkenntnissen und Erfahrung im Energiesektor sind ein Plus

Unser Offer

  • Mission & Growth: Werde Teil eines wachstumsstarken Scale-ups, das die Energiewende mit smarten, skalierbaren Lösungen aktiv vorantreibt
  • Impact auf allen Ebenen: Bei uns baust Du die Datenplattform, auf die sich das ganze Unternehmen verlässt, und siehst direkt, wie Deine Arbeit jedes Squad und jede Entscheidung im Unternehmen beeinflusst
  • Spot Spirit: Ein motiviertes, wertschätzendes Team mit kurzen Wegen, offener Kommunikation und Events, die uns zusammenschweißen
  • Flexibilität: Moderne, hybrid-friendly Arbeitsumgebung mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung

Unser Ziel ist es, durch präventive Dienstleistungsmedizin, eHealth und Public Health eine führende und wegweisende Rolle im Gesundheitssystem von morgen einzunehmen. Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denken Gesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Ein neuer Pfeiler dieser Vision ist : Mit unserem telemedizinischen Service bieten wir einen einfachen und sicheren Zugang zu medizinischem Cannabis, um Symptome zu lindern und die Lebensqualität zu verbessern. data.description:
Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.

About Superhuman

Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Business Operations Lead to partner with the leadership team of one of Superhuman’s Business Units (BUs) to drive strategic clarity, operational alignment, and execution across the BU’s most important initiatives. Our BUs are led by an Engineering, Product, Design, and Marketing (EPDM) leadership team — with the Product leader as the point of the spear — and this role exists to make that BU and its leadership team successful as we expand our product portfolio in a compound-startup model.

This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and cross-functional execution. You will solid-line into the Strategy & Operations organization and dotted-line into your Business Unit, giving you both a durable operating craft and deep proximity to the leaders you serve. You’ll turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans, closing the gap between strategic decisions and day-to-day execution as a permanent operational partner to the team — not a project manager cycling through initiatives with a wind-down date. Jetzt bewerben!

Werde Teil eines modernen Unternehmens mit klaren Strukturen, kurzen Entscheidungswegen und echten Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

data.title: Director of Go-to-Market Engineering (Revenue Operations)
data.description:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.


About the Role

We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering.

Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.

You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations, lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.

This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.

The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.

What You'll Do

Own the strategy and the stack

  • Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.

  • Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.

  • Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.

  • Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.

Build, hands-on

  • Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.

  • Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.

  • Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.

  • Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.

Automate across SDR, AE, and AM

  • Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.

  • Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.

  • Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.

  • Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.

Bridge commercial and technical

  • Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.

  • Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.

  • Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.

Build the team

  • Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

  • Set clear ownership, and the review discipline that makes shipping fast also means shipping safely.

  • Grow the team's technical depth and commercial judgement in equal measure.

What Will Make You Successful

Experience

  • Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS

  • Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team

  • Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.

Technical craft

  • Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.

  • Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.

  • Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.

  • Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.

  • Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling. Nobody has all of it. We care that you have real depth somewhere and can learn the rest quickly.

Commercial instinct

  • You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

  • You have the credibility with Sales leaders to scope the right build - and to say when automation is the wrong answer.

  • You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.

Nice to have

  • Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.

  • Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.

  • Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.

Why This Role

GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function. This is the chance to own it properly, the stack, the architecture, the build, and the commercial outcome across a $300M+ revenue business with 800 people in the field, a genuine appetite for automation, and the budget and executive backing to move fast.

You would be the first person in this seat, with real systems and real data to work with rather than a blank page, and the freedom to decide what Perk's automation layer should look like. There is a lot to go after, the problems are interesting, and the impact is immediate and visible.

If you want to build the automation layer of a commercial engine at this scale and you want to still have your hands on it come and build it here.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

data.title: Operations Controller FP&A (m/f/d), Xylem Analytics
data.description:
Water is our most valuable resource. Help protect it for future generations.

The global challenges surrounding water continue to grow. As a leading water technology company, Xylem develops innovative solutions that help communities and organizations use, treat, and reuse water more efficiently. With approximately 23,000 employees worldwide, we work every day to solve some of the world's most pressing water challenges.

Within Xylem Analytics Germany, we develop and market high-quality measurement and analytical systems across four locations in Germany. Our brands WTW, ebro, SI Analytics, and STM are among the leading providers of quantitative measurement solutions and water analytics technologies.

We currently have an open position as Operations Controller FP&A (m/f/d), Xylem Analytics at our site in Weilheim (Bavaria) or Mainz.

Aufgaben

This role provides combined FP&A and operational finance support to the Analytics business, with a strong focus on reporting, budgeting, inventory, cost, and operational performance management. Reporting solid-line into Global FP&A and operationally supporting the Ops Finance in Germany, the role ensures accurate reporting, disciplined inventory and cost controls, and effective execution of global and local finance processes.

Business Partnership & Support

  • Support Global FP&A and the Ops Finance with financial analysis and data preparation
  • Act as execution bridge between global FP&A requirements and local Operations Finance needs
  • Prepare insights and analyses for operational and financial reviews

Budgeting, Forecasting & Planning

  • Support budgeting, forecasting, and monthly reporting processes
  • Prepare variance analysis and identify key cost and performance drivers
  • Support backlog reporting and integration into FP&A forecasts

Reporting, Analytics & Controllership

  • Prepare or support reconciliations, validations, and accuracy checks
  • Support collaboration with Accounting on close and reporting topics

Operations Finance, Inventory & Cost

data.title: Business Ops Intern - People & Culture (f/m/x)
data.description:
Become a part of the 4screen team!

As a Business Ops Intern – People & Culture at 4screen, you will support our team across the full employee lifecycle – from recruiting and onboarding to offboarding and beyond. You'll help optimize P&C processes, support P&C administration and contract creation, and strengthen our company culture through initiatives like team events and employer branding. In addition, you'll support taking care of our office environment, ensuring it remains a welcoming space for collaboration and wellbeing. As part of our broader Business Operations team, you'll also gain exposure to various cross-functional projects along the way, gaining valuable insights into a dynamic and innovative workplace.

Tasks

You will contribute to our success by:

  • Supporting recruiting and hiring: You help manage job boards, monitor and respond to our recruiting inbox, and support candidates through the hiring process, including efforts to streamline our recruitment process.
  • Shaping onboarding and offboarding: You own key parts of the onboarding and offboarding admin process, keep our onboarding materials up to date, support exit interviews, and help create employment references.
  • Driving P&C administration and contracts: You support contract creation, help optimize internal and company-wide processes using AI and automation, and help collect and maintain personnel data in our P&C system (Personio).
  • Strengthening employee experience and culture: You contribute to internal communication formats and employer branding and help organize regular team and company initiatives that strengthen cohesion and team spirit.
  • Managing our office: You support day-to-day office management and help shape an office environment where the team feels comfortable and our culture is visible – bringing your own ideas to make it a hub for collaboration.
  • Drive cross-functional projects: You support cross-functional projects, building skills in project planning, stakeholder management, and communication, with insight into how Business Operations functions end-to-end at a scale-up.

Requirements

  • What makes you stand out:
    Completed or ongoing Master's degree, ideally in Business, Economics, or a related field
  • A genuine interest in processes, projects, and how People & Culture functions
  • Availability for a 6-month internship
  • Excellent German and English skills (at least B2+)
  • Previous internship or working student experience in HR or Operations (ideally in consulting, start-up, tech, or automotive) is a plus
  • Structured and independent working style, with strong attention to detail
  • Hands-on and can-do mindset, comfortable owning administrative and operational tasks alongside project work
  • Strong communication skills, initiative and an open and approachable manner
  • A true team player with curiosity and eagerness to learn

Benefits

  • What we offer:
    Gain firsthand experience in a dynamic and professional startup setting
  • Participating actively in crucial People & Culture processes and acquiring knowledge of best practices from top notch professionals
  • Relax during your 20 days of annual leave (+ public holidays)
  • Take care of your well-being with the support of our Egym Wellpass membership
  • Enjoy our flexible working hours policy in our open office in Munich’s vibrant Schwabing district
  • Have fun and enjoy the great team spirit at regular Team Events & Offsites, Pizza Nights, Game Nights, etc.

About us

Edit in settings

4screen is the world’s first Driver Interaction Platform, connecting brands & businesses with on-the-go customers in real time – directly through the car screen. By operating within the vehicle’s native digital interface, 4screen leverages dynamic car data to enhance the mobility experience – all in full compliance with the highest safety and privacy standards. 4screen is integrated into the operating systems of 16 leading automotive brands, including Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volkswagen, Toyota, Kia, Hyundai, and Stellantis. Today, more than 100 brands – including McDonald’s, Shell, and Waitrose – across 12 countries are already using the platform to reach drivers in meaningful, high-intent moments.

Our team at 4screen consists of a mix of young talents and industry experts that have previously been in leading positions at companies like BMW, Google or BCG. We are building a highly innovative company where everything is dynamic, disruptive, and exciting - and that you can be part of!

Are you ready to join the ride and shape the future of mobility?

  • Du stellst eine klare Kommunikation zwischen Mitarbeitenden, Kundenansprechpartnern und Geschäftsführung sicher.

  • Du reagierst souverän auf Abweichungen, Engpässe und kurzfristige operative Herausforderungen.

  • Du bist regelmäßig auf der Fläche präsent und gehst als Führungskraft voran.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Führungsfunktion in Produktion, Industrie, Metallverarbeitung, Gießerei, Logistik oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld.

  • Gute Kenntnisse in der Steuerung von Produktionsabläufen, Personalplanung und operativen Kennzahlen.

  • Ein gutes Gespür für Menschen sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams verbindlich, fair und klar zu führen.

  • Eine strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Durchsetzungsstärke, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität.

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Kontakt mit Kunden, Mitarbeitenden und internen Schnittstellen.

  • Führerschein Klasse B.

  • Zwingende Bereitschaft zum bundesweiten Umzug und zur dauerhaften Tätigkeit vor Ort an wechselnden Kunden- und Projektstandorten.

  • Projektbezogene Reisebereitschaft.

WARUM DIESE POSITION?

Diese Rolle ist für Menschen, die operative Führung ernst nehmen. Du gestaltest nicht aus der Distanz, sondern direkt dort, wo Leistung entsteht.

Du hast sichtbaren Einfluss auf Abläufe, Qualität, Produktivität und die Entwicklung deines Teams. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du eng mit unseren Kunden und der Geschäftsführung zusammen und kannst Prozesse aktiv weiterentwickeln.

data.title: (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d)
data.description:
Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. Werden Sie Teil dieses Erfolgs und bewerben Sie sich beim europäischen Marktführer der Branche.

Für unsere Unternehmensgruppe suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Sie als (Junior) Product Manager Quality & Fitting (m/w/d).


Was Sie bei uns bewegen:

  • Permanente Durchführung von Passform- und Qualitätskontrollen

  • Produktionsfreigabe anhand Mustertypen

  • Kontinuierlicher Austausch innerhalb des Produktmanagements und mit den internationalen Produktionsstätten

Was uns ausmacht:

  • Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit Gestaltungsspielraum, flachen Hierarchien und einer familiären Unternehmenskultur.

  • Alles, was Sie zum Arbeiten benötigen: Klimatisierte Büros, kostenlose Parkplätze sowie eine moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebung.

  • Ein Arbeitstag, wie für Sie gemacht: Dank unserer flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodelle und der Möglichkeit des mobilen Arbeitens können Sie Ihr Berufsleben optimal an ihr Privatleben anpassen.

  • Mit uns profitieren Sie von Sonderkonditionen und Angeboten bei verschiedensten Vertragspartnern über das Portal corporate Benefits.

  • Durch einen Mitarbeiterrabatt in unserem Fabrikverkauf sowie im Tamaris Onlineshop füllt sich der Schuhschrank wie von alleine.

  • Niemand tritt gerne auf der Stelle: Durch Schulungen und Seminare fördern wir Ihre persönliche und fachliche Weiterbildung, denn Ihr Karriereweg ist keine Einbahnstraße.

  • Fit und entspannt im Alltag: Durch verschiedene kostenlose Betriebssportgruppen, eine Kooperation mit lokalen Fitnessstudios sowie mit dem Anbieter sportnavi.de.

  • Wir feiern Erfolg und Gemeinschaft: Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Team-Events und Firmenfeiern sind ein fester Bestandteil unserer Unternehmenskultur.


Was Sie ausmacht:

  • Schuhgröße 37, Fußlänge 231 – 236 mm, durchschnittliche Fuß- und Wadenform

  • Großes Interesse an Mode und Schuhen sowie ein starkes Bewusstsein für die Qualität von Materialien und deren Verarbeitung

  • Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit gepaart mit guten Englischkenntnissen in Wort und Schrift

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung wünschenswert; gerne auch Quereinsteiger

  • Hohes Engagement

  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Reisen

Sie sind ein verantwortungsbewusster und äußerst engagierter Teamplayer und schätzen die konstruktive Zusammenarbeit? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre aussagefähigen Bewerbungsunterlagen.

data.title: Founding Product Manager
data.description:
At TechBiz Global, we are providing recruitment service to our TOP clients from our portfolio. We are currently seeking a Founding Product Manager to join one of our clients' team. If you're looking for an exciting opportunity to grow in a innovative environment, this could be the perfect fit for you.

Berlin • Cybersecurity & AI Startup • Recently Funded

A newly funded cybersecurity startup in Berlin is looking for a Founding Product Manager to join as a founding team member and help design the core security, identity, and enforcement foundations of a next-generation AI-powered security risk management platform.

It’s an early-stage startup founded by experienced cybersecurity leaders with backgrounds in Israeli Intelligence units. We are looking for a hands-on Founding Product Manager for a hybrid role based in central of Berlin. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and AI tech, thrive in fast-paced startup environments, and enjoy building complex platforms from the ground up, this is an opportunity to make a real impact.

They’re building a next-generation cyber risk platform that helps enterprises understand, measure, and reduce identity risk at scale. Our goal is to turn complex identity and security data into clear, actionable risk insights that CISOs and CTOs can trust. You will work from scratch on core platform components from day one, shaping how modern enterprises manage and reason about risk using cloud-native systems and AI-driven analysis and automated enforcement through AI Agents.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and build product for new cyber security product from scratch

  • Design end-to-end user journeys across the entire platform, from onboarding to daily usage and advanced workflows

  • Define platform information architecture, navigation, and core UX principles

  • Own wireframes, user flows, and interaction logic (from low-fidelity to production-ready concepts)

  • Prepare tickets and own backlog

  • Translate user needs, risk scenarios, and business goals into intuitive UI/UX decisions

  • Contribute the product vision and translate it into a clear, actionable roadmap

  • Ensure complex security and risk concepts are expressed in simple, usable interfaces

  • Drive product discovery, validation, and prioritization from day zero

  • Work closely with engineering, security, and data teams to ship the right product fast

  • Define MVP scope, iterate based on real customer feedback, and avoid over-engineering

  • Balance security, usability, and scalability in a complex cyber risk platform

  • Represent the product internally and externally with customers, partners, and investors

  • Build whole platform from scratch


Must have skills:

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience designing complex B2B SaaS web platforms for technical products

  • Proven ability to scatch end-to-end user journeys using Figma (flows, wireframes, interactive prototypes)

  • Strong experience with design systems and component-based UX (Figma libraries, tokens, variants)

  • Ability to write clear PRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria in Notion, Confluence, or similar

  • Experience working closely with engineering teams using Jira, Linear, or GitHub Projects

  • Solid understanding of REST APIs of SaaS integrations and backend-driven UIs (can read OpenAPI / Swagger specs)

  • Experience defining data-heavy dashboards (tables, filters, charts, drill-downs)

  • Strong grasp of UX for complex domains (security, risk, finance, compliance, or enterprise admin tools)

  • Familiarity with event tracking and product analytics

  • Experience in using TOP product AI tools

  • Ability to run user interviews and usability testing and translate findings into product decisions

  • Strong understanding Ability to build things from scratch at early stage startup

  • High ownership mentality, startup mindset, and ability to move quickly.

  • Experience in startup or scale-up environments

  • Low ego, high commitment, and a true tech startup mentality.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.

  • Excellent English communication skills

Nice-to-have requirements:

  • Experience with cybersecurity, IAM, GRC, or risk management platforms

  • Understanding of RBAC / ABAC, permissions modeling, and role-based UX

  • Experience working with AI-powered features (recommendations, scoring, summaries, user flow generators)

  • Familiarity with data visualization libraries

  • Exposure to frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Vue (no coding required)

  • Experience collaborating with teams using Go, Java, or Python backends

  • Understanding of enterprise buying personas (CISO, CTO, Security, Risk teams)

  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS platforms

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (NIS2, DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2)

  • Experience in security or risk management products

  • Experience designing permission models, identity graphs, or access control frameworks.

  • Exposure to graph-based modeling (identity graph, access graph, risk graph)

  • Familiarity with AI agents implementations

  • Previous experience in cybersecurity, identity startups.

  • You are a fan of rock or metal music.

  • Excellent German communication skills

Benefits:

  • Founding Team Member Equity — ESOPs in a cybersecurity company

  • Competitive Compensation — salary aligned with market, flexible early-stage arrangements possible

  • Founding Team Member Status — shape the company from day one and own critical product decisions

  • Fresh Funding Secured — immediate runway to build, hire, and execute fast

  • Security Contribution — contribute to security product across identity, AI agents, and enforcement

  • High Autonomy — freedom to design and build without corporate overhead

  • Work with a Technical CEO and CPTO — fast iteration, strong alignment, clear direction

  • Cutting-Edge Domain — identity security, SaaS-to-SaaS access, AI agent governance

  • Massive Learning Curve — quickly gain depth in cybersecurity, identity, and AI systems

  • Fast Career Path — opportunity evolve into leadership as we scale the product team

  • Berlin Location — top-tier tech environment with strong cybersecurity and AI ecosystems

  • Direct Impact — your product vision become the foundation of the entire platform

  • Best Equipment and Tools - High quality equipment and modern tools to help you do your best work from day one

  • Team Offsites - Regular team offsites designed to build strong connections, alignment, and shared momentum

data.title: Fullstack-Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wir suchen jemanden, der wirklich mitbaut.

Lippe Personal ist seit 2017 auf einen Markt spezialisiert, der gerade unter Druck steht: Arztpraxen, Zahnarztpraxen, Physiotherapeuten und Apotheken in Deutschland finden kaum noch qualifiziertes Personal. Der Fachkräftemangel ist real, die Digitalisierung in diesem Bereich steckt noch in den Kinderschuhen, und die Lösungen, die es heute gibt, sind nicht für die Nutzer gebaut, die sie eigentlich brauchen.

Das wollen wir ändern.

Wir bauen gerade eine digitale Plattform auf, die den medizinischen Arbeitsmarkt im DACH-Raum neu strukturiert. Datengetrieben, mobil-first, mit einem klaren Fokus auf echten Nutzen fuer Praxen und Bewerber. data.description:
Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail, and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers, including Google Maps and Booking.com.

We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by leading venture capital investors including TQ Ventures, Lightrock, Creandum, and Northzone, and are headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Demand Product team. In this key role, you'll shape the core infrastructure that powers Distribusion's entire marketplace — the API and platform capabilities that sit at the heart of our customer success strategy. Your focus will be on driving the reliability, scalability, and quality of our platform, ensuring it maintains the highest functional standards across all scenarios, while developing strategic initiatives that future-proof our technology and enable growth at a global scale.

What you will do:

  • Define and maintain short and mid-term product roadmaps, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and the organisation to transform our platform into a world-class transportation marketplace.

  • Take full ownership of strategic projects end-to-end — from defining business needs and developing user stories through to UAT — ensuring delivery meets customer expectations and exceeds quality standards.

  • Work closely with Engineering, QA and other stakeholders to run an adaptive Scrum process that ensures seamless, on-time feature delivery from ideation through to execution.

  • Monitor key metrics such as usage, adoption, and quality SLAs, proposing continuous improvements to keep our platform competitive and reliable at scale.

  • Prepare detailed use cases and collaborate with teams to align on technical solutions and achieve critical objectives on time.

  • Write clear user documentation that improves system usability for internal and external users, establishing the best integration experience on the market.

Workplace:

We are mainly looking for this role to be based within Germany, preferably in our HQ in Berlin.

We are a remote-first company, with teams located around the Globe and our HQ office in Berlin, where the team often meets in the office.


Who you are:

  • Background in the role of a Senior or Lead Product Manager in high-load systems and/or complex B2B product management.

data.title: Staff Security Engineer
data.description:
At PPRO, we simplify access to local payments - providing a local payments platform that empowers giants like PayPal, Stripe, and Microsoft to connect with billions of consumers worldwide. We are on an ambitious, fast-paced mission to 3x our growth by 2028 - and we’re just getting started.

Our magic lies in our team of proud payments nerds. Spanning over 50 nationalities across 10+ global locations, our diverse cultures aren't a checklist; they are the competitive advantage driving our innovation. This is a people-first, high trust environment where you’ll have the autonomy to make a massive impact, own your work end-to-end, and grow through broad exposure, meaningful challenges, and continuous learning. We get things done, challenge respectfully, put the customer first, and recognise that our biggest successes are those we create as a team. If you’re ready to leave your footprint on global commerce, join us.
 
The Purpose:

As Staff Security Engineer at PPRO, you’ll act as the technical lead for the Security Engineering (SecEng) team, driving technical and operational excellence while coaching and developing your colleagues. You’ll be pivotal in supporting our mission to build robust, secure, and resilient systems.

This role offers the opportunity to apply deep security expertise across application and cloud domains. You will serve as the primary technical interface between the SecEng team and engineers across the organisation, influencing architecture and guiding teams to embed a 'secure by design' philosophy in everything we build. You will build Security as Code solutions that enable consistent controls and high-velocity delivery. You will also perform security assessments for new projects and technologies, utilizing threat modeling to identify risks early and define standardized, repeatable security patterns for the wider engineering organization. If you thrive on finding win-win solutions that embed security into modern development workflows to safeguard our customers, this is a great opportunity to have a positive impact at scale across the payments ecosystem.


What you’ll do:
  • Act as technical lead for the Security Engineering team, setting technical direction, coaching and mentoring other security engineers.
  • Partner with Engineering teams to integrate security principles, practices, and tools into all stages of the software development lifecycle.
  • Design and build reusable Security as Code artefacts and patterns that reduce developer friction while improving security outcomes.
  • Conduct threat modeling exercises and security assessments to identify and address risks in critical applications and systems.
  • Write Hardening Standards and Security Guidelines for various technologies and processes.
  • Develop automations for recurrent and manual tasks around auditing activities, cloud security posture management (CSPM) and other security processes.
  • Maintain and expand our IaC codebase and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Champion the use of AI to streamline security operations, scaling our defensive capabilities and enabling non-security teams to adopt security-first practices.
  • Collaborate on cross-functional security projects, enhancing PPRO’s security posture at scale.
  • Continuously monitor emerging security trends and technologies to drive proactive improvements.

    • What we look for in you:
  • A natural technical leader: able to guide, coach and mentor engineers, lead cross-team collaborations, and act as a trusted interface between security and the wider engineering organisation.
  • You view AI as an essential force multiplier; you are a power user who actively leverages modern AI/LLM frameworks to both accelerate your own workflows and build scalable security solutions.
  • Solid understanding of software engineering fundamentals, secure software development best practices and security architecture.
  • Strong expertise in AWS (GCP is a bonus) and container security (e.g. Kubernetes).
  • Deep understanding of DevSecOps and CI/CD security controls, with hands-on experience in Infrastructure as Code (preferably Terraform), CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions) and scripting (Python, bash).
  • Results-oriented, highly collaborative, pragmatic and proactive, and with a continuous improvement mindset.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, able to unblock teams and foster security awareness throughout the company.
    • What's in it for you?
     
    Hybrid working - We offer a hybrid structure with a 3 days / week on site expectation, so you can strike the balance between office and home working. In addition to our 30-day holiday allowance, we also provide a work from abroad policy, enabling employees to work remotely for up to another 30 days per year.
     
    Learning and Development - We offer a €1,000 annual budget to support your professional growth—because investing in your development benefits us all. In addition, we provide leadership cafés, on-the-job training, and other opportunities to help you grow your skills and thrive in your role.
     
    Insurance - Because better safe than sorry - we want our employees to benefit from various insurances including accident insurance, disability insurance, direct insurance (bAV) and travel insurance. 
     
    Gym membership - PPRO helps contribute towards the costs of your gym membership, supporting your physical fitness journey while easing the burden on your wallet
     
    Enhance Family Leave - We understand the importance of family - that's why we offer enhanced family leave to support you during key life moments.
     
     
    Mental Health Platform - We’ve teamed up with a top well-being platform to provide one-on-one therapy, chat therapy, therapist-led courses, guided meditations, and more.
     
    Pet-friendly office - Because work is better with your paw-tners by your side
     
     
    Our Principles: 
     
    We get things done: We are courageous; we take ownership, make decisions and get things done.
     
    We act with trust and integrity: We listen first and challenge respectfully. We seek out and leverage diverse perspectives. We welcome and offer honest and open feedback, always assuming positive intent
     
    We put the customer first: We are laser focused on delivering outstanding outcomes for our customers. We put the customer at the heart of what we do.
     
    We make things better: We boldly explore  new ideas and have an unwavering commitment to continuous improvement.
     
    We work as a team: We collaborate closely and value team success over individual achievement.

data.title: Senior AI Agent Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Beam AI builds self-learning AI agents and an organisational operating system where intelligence grows through autonomous discovery. We help enterprises evolve from AI-curious to AI-native with automation that delivers results today and learns to improve itself over time. Join us in shaping a future where AI continuously discovers, adapts, and makes work more meaningful. To learn more, visit https://beam.ai/.

About the Team

Beam’s AI Agent Deployment team sits at the intersection of AI, product, and client impact. We partner closely with customers to understand their workflows, design intelligent automation solutions, and ensure our agents deliver real business value. Our work spans workflow design, agent configuration, technical integration, and ongoing optimization. We collaborate with engineering, ML, and product teams to translate abstract problems into scalable, agentic systems that work in the real world. This is a high-context, high-ownership environment where Deployment engineers operate with autonomy, move fast, and shape both how Beam’s platform evolves and how our customers succeed.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Agent Engineer at Beam, you will play a key role in delivering enterprise-grade AI automations tailored to real business processes. You’ll work directly with clients to understand their requirements, break down complex workflows, and design prompt-driven agents that solve high-impact problems. You'll also support integration efforts with client systems and ensure smooth delivery from concept to deployment.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a hands-on, fast-moving environment, with a strong technical foundation, programming skills, a process-oriented mindset, and a passion for AI. You should feel confident working with APIs, designing robust automations, and collaborating across teams to turn business needs into working solutions. If you enjoy working across clients, technology, and automation, and want to build things that work in the real world, this is the role for you.

Responsibilities

Your work will involve both prompt engineering excellence and close customer collaboration. You will be expected to:

  • Partner with enterprise customers to identify automation opportunities, gather requirements, and translate business problems into agent-powered solutions
  • Design and build agentic automations using Beam's Agent OS. This includes scoping workflows, engineering prompts, and configuring integrations
  • Manage delivery end-to-end: timelines, client expectations, and stakeholder communication across technical and executive audiences
  • Troubleshoot and iterate on live automations by diagnosing issues, refining prompts, and improving performance
  • Collaborate with product and engineering to scope features, surface platform gaps, and feed customer insights back into the roadmap
  • Act as a strategic advisor to clients on AI adoption, workflow automation best practices, and integration architecture

Requirements

  • 2-3 years in a client-facing technical role such as Solutions Engineer, Implementation Consultant, Deployment Engineer, Customer Engineer, or similar
  • Strong project management and communication skills. You can run delivery timelines, manage client expectations, and explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and executives
  • Demonstrated prompt engineering expertise. You've systematically written, tested, and optimized prompts in production or near-production settings
  • Experience automating workflows with AI. You've used AI to automate real business processes, not just experimented in sandboxes
  • Solid API knowledge and integration experience. You're comfortable scoping and coordinating API-based integrations with external systems
  • Analytical, process-driven thinking. You can take a messy business workflow, break it into structured components, and design an automation approach

Nice to Have

  • AI/ML background or hands-on experience applying AI to business workflows
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

How We Hire

  • Our process includes a case study where you'll work on a realistic automation challenge: designing an extraction prompt, building a project plan, and presenting your approach. We want to see how you think, not just what you know.

Benefits

At Beam, we’re building an environment where ambitious people can do their best work, with clarity, purpose, and room to grow. We’re thoughtful about what we build, how we work, and who we hire. The problems we’re solving are real. The systems we’re building are complex. And the people here care deeply, about craft, about speed, and about doing work that actually matters. You won’t find rigid hierarchies or endless process here. You’ll find high trust, high standards, and a team driven by curiosity, ownership, and long-term thinking.

Our culture is shaped by our values in action:

  • AI-native thinking: Every teammate thinks in agentic workflows, uses AI tools daily, and looks for leverage through automation. AI isn’t just what we build, it's how we operate.
  • Customer obsession: We build with urgency and empathy, speak to customers early and often, and measure success through their outcomes.
  • Speed as a habit: We ship fast, learn faster, and prioritise unblocking over perfection. We favour small experiments with tight feedback loops.
  • Leverage-focused execution: We hire high-impact players, invest in the 20% that drives 80% of results, and value candid feedback.
  • Highly aligned, loosely coupled: We align on outcomes, not tasks. You’ll work independently, but never in isolation.
  • Data-driven, human-guided: We seek clarity over comfort, speak up early, and use feedback to grow together.

If this sounds like the kind of work you want to do and the kind of team you want to grow with, we’d love to hear from you!

EMPIT ist ein wachsendes Deep-Tech-Unternehmen, das Mess- und Inspektionssysteme für den internationalen Einsatz an kritischer Infrastruktur entwickelt. Mit unseren Technologien machen wir sichtbar, was sonst verborgen bleibt, und leisten damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Sicherheit und Zuverlässigkeit kritischer Infrastruktur.

In deiner Rolle entwickelst und optimierst du die Elektronik hinter diesen Systemen – von leistungsfähigen Stromversorgungen und Platinen bis hin zur Neukonzeption einzelner Komponenten unserer Signalgeneratoren. Dabei entstehen Lösungen, die kompakt, zuverlässig und für den internationalen Einsatz ausgelegt sind. 

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Stromversorgungen weiterentwickeln: Leistungsfähigkeit, Effizienz und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Stromquellen verbessern und auf die Anforderungen unserer Messsysteme abstimmen.
  • Platinen und elektronische Baugruppen entwickeln: Schaltungen aufbauen, Prototypen in Betrieb nehmen, Messergebnisse bewerten und bestehende Hardware gezielt optimieren.
  • Elektronik kompakter machen: Bestehende Baugruppen hinsichtlich Größe, Gewicht und Aufbau optimieren, damit unsere Systeme sicher und effizient transportiert werden können – auch per Flugzeug.
  • Signalgeneratoren neu denken: Bestehende Komponenten analysieren, technische Grenzen hinterfragen und neue Lösungen für unsere Signalgeneratoren und Messsysteme entwickeln.
  • Technische Herausforderungen lösen: Fehler systematisch analysieren, Ursachen identifizieren und eigenständig praxistaugliche Lösungen bis zur Umsetzung bringen.
  • Technologie mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit unserem Team neue Konzepte entwickeln und technische Entscheidungen für die nächste Generation unserer Mess- und Inspektionssysteme vorantreiben.


Was Du bei uns bekommst

  • Urban Sports Club und EGYM Wellpass: Durch unseren Zuschuss kannst du kostengünstig Sport in ganz Deutschland treiben.

  • Raum für deine Ideen: Deine Ideen sind bei uns nicht nur willkommen, sondern gewünscht – bringe dich ein und gestalte die Zukunft von EMPIT aktiv mit.


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Hardware- bzw. Elektronikentwicklung

data.title: Senior CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security / CSPM Engineer (m/w/d)
data.description:
Wer wir sind

Wir sind die AJAT GmbH, ein IT und Cybersecurity Unternehmen aus Köln. Wir unterstützen Unternehmen dabei, ihre IT und Cloud Umgebungen sicherer, stabiler und besser steuerbar zu machen.

Bei uns arbeitest du nicht irgendwo im Hintergrund an kleinen Einzelaufgaben. Du wirst direkt in anspruchsvolle Kundenprojekte eingebunden und kannst deine Erfahrung von der Planung bis zur technischen Umsetzung einbringen.

Aktuell bauen wir unseren Bereich rund um CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security weiter aus. Dafür suchen wir jemanden, der CrowdStrike nicht nur aus Schulungen oder Präsentationen kennt, sondern bereits praktisch damit gearbeitet hat.

Worum es bei der Stelle geht

Gemeinsam mit unserem Security Architekten führst du CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security in größeren AWS und Azure Umgebungen ein.

Du begleitest das Projekt von der ersten Bestandsaufnahme über die Architektur und Konfiguration bis zur technischen Prüfung und Übergabe an den späteren Betrieb.

Dabei geht es insbesondere um CSPM, Cloud Berechtigungen, Compliance Kontrollen, Entra ID, Reporting und den richtigen Umgang mit Findings.

Aufgaben

• Du analysierst gemeinsam mit uns die vorhandene AWS und Azure Umgebung des Kunden.

• Du hilfst dabei, den genauen Umfang, die Ziele und die Erfolgskriterien der Einführung festzulegen.

• Du entwickelst eine verständliche und technisch umsetzbare CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security Architektur.

• Du bindest AWS Organizations, AWS Accounts, Azure Tenants und Azure Subscriptions an CrowdStrike Falcon an.

• Du richtest die benötigten Zugriffsrechte und Cloud Berechtigungen ein.

• Du achtest darauf, dass CrowdStrike nur die Berechtigungen erhält, die tatsächlich benötigt werden.

• Du prüfst, ob alle vereinbarten Cloud Ressourcen richtig erkannt und dargestellt werden.

• Du konfigurierst CrowdStrike CSPM passend zu den Sicherheitsanforderungen des Kunden.

• Du aktivierst und prüfst CIS Benchmarks und weitere vereinbarte Sicherheitskontrollen.

• Du konfigurierst Policies, Risikoschwellen, Ausnahmen und Benachrichtigungen.

• Du führst die erste Bewertung der Cloud Sicherheitslage durch und besprichst die Ergebnisse mit den verantwortlichen Teams.

• Du unterstützt bei der Integration von Microsoft Entra ID.

• Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden ein sinnvolles Rollen und Berechtigungsmodell.

• Du prüfst, ob Benutzer, Gruppen und Rollen korrekt zugeordnet sind.

• Du hilfst dabei, Findings nach Risiko, Kritikalität und Verantwortlichkeit zu sortieren.

• Du definierst gemeinsam mit dem Kunden, welches Team welche Findings erhält und wie die weitere Bearbeitung erfolgt.

• Du entwickelst passende Dashboards und Kennzahlen für Security, IT Betrieb und Management.

• Du dokumentierst die vorgenommenen Einstellungen und wichtigen Entscheidungen verständlich.

• Du prüfst am Ende, ob die vereinbarten Funktionen, Integrationen und Sicherheitskontrollen richtig funktionieren.

• Du unterstützt bei der Behebung technischer Probleme während der Einführung.

• Du bereitest die Lösung für die Übergabe an den späteren Betrieb vor.

Qualifikation

Wichtig ist uns vor allem, dass du bereits praktisch mit CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security gearbeitet hast.

Du solltest wissen, wie AWS und Azure Umgebungen angebunden werden und wie man anschließend prüft, ob die Verbindung, Berechtigungen und Daten vollständig sind.

Du solltest dich mit folgenden Themen gut auskennen:

!!! DEUTSCH und Englisch MINDESTENS C1 LEVEL !!!

• CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security

• Cloud Security Posture Management

• AWS Organizations und AWS IAM

• Azure Tenants, Subscriptions und Azure RBAC

• Microsoft Entra ID

• Rollen und Berechtigungskonzepte

• CIS Benchmarks und Compliance Kontrollen

• Security Policies und Ausnahmeregelungen

• Bewertung und Priorisierung von Cloud Findings

• Reporting und Security Dashboards

• Technische Dokumentation

Folgende Erfahrungen und Zertifizierungen sind von Vorteil, aber nicht alle zwingend erforderlich:

• CrowdStrike Certified Cloud Specialist

• CrowdStrike Certified Falcon Administrator

• AWS Certified Security Specialty

• Microsoft Azure Security Engineer Associate

• Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator

• Erfahrung mit CrowdStrike Fusion SOAR

• Erfahrung mit CrowdStrike APIs

• Erfahrung mit SIEM oder Ticketing Systemen

• Kenntnisse in Terraform

• Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Container Security

Du solltest außerdem in der Lage sein, technische Themen verständlich zu erklären. Bei diesem Projekt arbeitest du nicht nur in der CrowdStrike Konsole, sondern auch mit verschiedenen Ansprechpartnern aus Security, Cloud, IAM, Compliance und IT Betrieb zusammen.

Benefits

Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und ein Cloud Security Projekt wirklich mitzugestalten.

Du arbeitest direkt mit unseren Security Spezialisten und der Geschäftsführung zusammen. Entscheidungen werden bei uns schnell und gemeinsam getroffen.

Wir unterstützen dich bei fachlichen Schulungen und CrowdStrike Zertifizierungen. Wenn du bereits praktische CrowdStrike Erfahrung besitzt, aber noch nicht alle Zertifikate abgeschlossen hast, ist das für uns kein Ausschlussgrund.

Wir bieten dir flexible Arbeitszeiten, eine hybride Zusammenarbeit, moderne technische Ausstattung und langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb unseres Cloud und Cybersecurity Bereichs.

Du brauchst kein klassisches Anschreiben.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und erzähle uns kurz, mit welchen CrowdStrike Produkten du bisher gearbeitet hast.

Besonders interessieren uns folgende Punkte:

• Welche AWS oder Azure Umgebungen hast du angebunden?

• Welche Aufgaben hast du selbst durchgeführt?

• Hast du CrowdStrike CSPM bereits produktiv konfiguriert?

• Hast du Entra ID oder ein anderes Identitätssystem integriert?

• Wie viele Cloud Accounts, Subscriptions oder Workloads hast du betreut?

• Welche CrowdStrike oder Cloud Zertifizierungen besitzt du?

Wenn du nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt erfüllst, aber bereits praktische Erfahrung mit CrowdStrike Falcon Cloud Security hast, möchten wir dich trotzdem gerne kennenlernen.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.
